paragraphs: Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems, and you want AI to be safe and beneficial for users and for society as a whole. As a member of the Applied AI team, you will be a Forward Deployed Engineer who embeds directly with strategic customers to drive transformational AI adoption and represent Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. You will work within customer systems to build production applications with Claude models, deliver technical artifacts such as MCP servers, sub‑agents, and agent skills for production workflows, provide white‑glove deployment support in enterprise environments, and maintain strong knowledge of the latest LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks, and to foster collaborative innovation across multidisciplinary teams worldwide for impact.

The LLMs requirement matches my experience. I built agentic solutions in Python backed by PostgreSQL and continuous integration, creating stakeholder‑focused prototypes that exercised advanced prompt engineering and agent development. I also delivered MCP‑based search services using GraphQL and open‑weight models, again leveraging PostgreSQL for persistent state and CI pipelines to ensure reliable deployment at scale. Both efforts produced production‑ready artifacts that align with the need for Claude models, sub‑agents, and MCP servers, demonstrating my ability to ship effective applications that meet rigorous technical standards.

The research pillar also aligns with my background. I designed an agent using LangChain and deployed it on AWS Bedrock, addressing hallucination risk while integrating APIs for flexible data access, and the system produced a 19,213‑gene parquet fallback for downstream analysis. In addition, I carried out systematic evaluation of model outputs, establishing metrics that support safe and interpretable AI behaviour. These projects illustrate my capacity to conduct rigorous research, translate findings into production‑grade tools, and contribute to the advancement of trustworthy AI.
